1.word_for_word: ततो भागवत-व्याख्या-द्वारैव दशमे स्फुटम् । — Then, through the explanation of the Bhagavad-gītā, it is clear in the tenth chapter.; राज-प्रश्नोत्तरं वक्तुम् आरेभे बादरायणिः ॥१॥ — Badarayani began to answer the king's questions.; दश-लक्षणं पुराणं प्राहेत्य् उक्तम् । — It is said that the Purāṇa has ten characteristics.; तानि दश लक्षानि दर्शयति—अत्रेति । — He shows those ten lakhs—here.; मन्वन्तराणि ईशानुकथाश् चेति द्वन्द्वः । — There is a duality between the manvas and the stories of the Lord.; सर्गादयोऽत्र दशार्था लक्ष्यन्ते ॥१॥ — The ten meanings of creation and others are observed here.
1.translation: Then, through the explanation of the Bhagavad-gītā, it is clear in the tenth chapter. Badarayani began to answer the king's questions. It is said that the Purāṇa has ten characteristics. He shows those ten lakhs—here. There is a duality between the manvas and the stories of the Lord. The ten meanings of creation and others are observed here.

2.word_for_word: नन्व् एवम् अर्थ-भेदाच् छास्त्र-भेदः स्यात् ? — Is there a difference in scripture from such a difference in meaning?; तत्राह । — There he says.; दशमस्याश्रयस्य विशुद्ध्य्-अर्थं तत्त्व-ज्ञानार्थं नवानां लक्षणं स्वरूपम् । — The tenth is the characteristic form of the new ones for the purpose of purifying the shelter and for the purpose of knowing the truth.; एकस्यैव प्राधान्यान् नायं दोष इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that there is nothing wrong with the priorities of one.; नन्व् अत्र नैवं प्रतीयतेऽत आह । — Now, it does not seem so here, so he argues.; श्रुतेन श्रुत्यैव स्तुत्य्-आदि-स्थानेष्व् अञ्जसा साक्षाद् वर्णयन्ति । — They easily describe it directly in places such as praise by hearing it.; अर्थेन तात्पर्य-वृत्त्या च तत्-तद्-आख्यानेषु ॥२॥ — by the meaning and the function of the meaning in the respective narratives.
2.translation: Is there a difference in scripture from such a difference in meaning? There he says. The tenth is the characteristic form of the new ones for the purpose of purifying the shelter and for the purpose of knowing the truth. This means that there is nothing wrong with the priorities of one. Now, it does not seem so here, so he argues. They easily describe it directly in places such as praise by hearing it. by the meaning and the function of the meaning in the respective narratives.

3.word_for_word: सर्गादीनां प्रत्येकं लक्षणम् आह । — He describes each of the characteristics of creation and other things.; भूतान्य् आकाशादीनि, मात्राणि च शब्दादीनि, इन्द्रियाणि च, धी-शब्देन महद्-अहंकारौ । — Beings, such as the sky, and matter, such as sound, and the senses, are the great ego by the word intellect.; गुणानां वैषम्यात् परिणामाद् ब्रह्मणः परमेश्वरात् कर्तुर् भूतादीनां यद् विराट्-रूपेण स्वरूपतश् च जन्म स सर्गः । — The birth of all living entities in the form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, as a result of the unevenness of the modes of nature, is called creation.; विसर्गम् आह । — He said the consonant.; पुरुषो वैराजस् तत्-कृतः पौरुषश् चराचर-सर्गो विसर्ग इत्य् अर्थः ॥३॥ — The Purusha is Vairaja, the Purusha created by Him, the creation of all moving and non-moving beings, and the Visarga, that is, the Purusha.
3.translation: He describes each of the characteristics of creation and other things. Beings, such as the sky, and matter, such as sound, and the senses, are the great ego by the word intellect. The birth of all living entities in the form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, as a result of the unevenness of the modes of nature, is called creation. He said the consonant. The Purusha is Vairaja, the Purusha created by Him, the creation of all moving and non-moving beings, and the Visarga, that is, the Purusha.

4.word_for_word: वैकुण्ठस्य भगवतो विजयः सृष्टानां तत्-तन्-मर्यादा-पालनेनोत्कर्षः । — The victory of the Supreme Personality of Godhead in Vaikuṇṭha is the victory of all creatures by observing His own boundaries.; स्थितिः स्थानम् । — Position: Location.; स्व-भक्तेषु तस्यानुग्रहः पोषणम् । — His mercy to His devotees is His nourishment.; तद्-अनुगृहीतानां सतां मन्वन्तराधिपतीनां धर्मः सद्-धर्मः । — The religion of the virtuous rulers of the Manus, who are favored by Him, is the religion of the virtuous.; कर्मणां वासनाः । — The desires of the actions.; ऊयन्ते कर्मभिः सन्तन्यन्त इत्य् ऊतयः । — They are woven by actions, and they are propagated by their actions.; यद् वा, वृद्ध्य्-अर्थात् संश्लेषार्थाद् वावतेर् धातोर् इदं रूपम् । — That is, this is the form of the verb vavati, which means to increase, to synthesize.; ऊयन्ते कर्मभिर् बृंह्यन्ते संश्लिष्यन्त इति वा ऊतय इत्य् अर्थः ॥४॥ — They are woven, they are enlarged by actions, or they are joined together, this means that they are woven.
4.translation: The victory of the Supreme Personality of Godhead in Vaikuṇṭha is the victory of all creatures by observing His own boundaries. Position: Location. His mercy to His devotees is His nourishment. The religion of the virtuous rulers of the Manus, who are favored by Him, is the religion of the virtuous. The desires of the actions. They are woven by actions, and they are propagated by their actions. That is, this is the form of the verb vavati, which means to increase, to synthesize. They are woven, they are enlarged by actions, or they are joined together, this means that they are woven.

5.word_for_word: हरेर् अवतारानुचरितम् अस्यानुवर्तिनां च सत्-कथा ईशानुकथाः प्रोक्ता इत्य् अर्थः ॥५॥ — This means that the characteristics of the incarnations of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and the true stories of His followers have been described as the stories of the Lord.
5.translation: This means that the characteristics of the incarnations of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and the true stories of His followers have been described as the stories of the Lord.

6.word_for_word: निरोधम् आह । — He argues for inhibition.; अस्यात्मनो जीवस्य हरेर् योग-निद्राम् अनु पश्चाच् छक्तिभिश् चोपाधिभिः सह शयनं लयो निरोधः । — This soul, the living entity, follows the yogic sleep of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and afterwards lies down with the powers and the objects of merging and restraint.; अन्यथा रूपम् अविद्ययाध्यस्तं कर्तृत्वादि हित्वा स्वरूपेण ब्रह्मतया व्यवस्थितिर् मुक्तिः ॥६॥ — Otherwise, having abandoned the form, which is under the control of ignorance, as the doer and the others, and having established oneself in the form of the Absolute Truth, liberation is attained.
6.translation: He argues for inhibition. This soul, the living entity, follows the yogic sleep of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and afterwards lies down with the powers and the objects of merging and restraint. Otherwise, having abandoned the form, which is under the control of ignorance, as the doer and the others, and having established oneself in the form of the Absolute Truth, liberation is attained.

7.word_for_word: आभासः सृष्टिर् निरोधो लयश् च यतो भवत्य् अध्यवसीयते प्रकाशते च स परं ब्रह्मेति परमात्मेति प्रसिद्ध आश्रयः कथ्यते ॥७॥ — That Supreme Brahman from whom illusion, creation, restraint and annihilation arise, determine and manifest is called the well-known shelter, the Supreme Self.
7.translation: That Supreme Brahman from whom illusion, creation, restraint and annihilation arise, determine and manifest is called the well-known shelter, the Supreme Self.

8.word_for_word: आश्रय-स्वरूपम् अपरोक्षानुभवेन स्पष्टं दर्शयितुम् अध्यात्मादि-विभागम् आह । — To show clearly by indirect experience the nature of dependence, he argues for the division of spirituality and others.; योऽयम् आध्यात्मिकः पुरुषश् चक्षुर्-आदि-करणाभिमानी द्रष्टा जीवः स एवाधिदैविकश् चक्षुर्-आद्य्-अधिष्ठाता सूर्यादिः । — This spiritual being, the seer, who is proud of the eyes and other senses, is the same superdivine being, the sun and others, who are the master of the eyes and other senses.; तत्रैकस्मिन्न् एवोभयो द्वि-रूपो विच्छेदो यस्मात् स आधिभौतिकश् चक्षुर्-गोलकाद्य्-उपलक्षितो दृश्यो देहः पुरुष इति पुरुषस्य जीवस्योपाधिः । — There is a separation of both in the same two-form, from which the transcendental, visible body, perceived by the eye, the sphere, etc., is the soul, and the soul is the soul.; स वा एष पुरुषोऽन्न-रस-मयः इत्य्-आदि-श्रुतेः ॥८॥ — That or this Purusha is made up of food and taste, according to the original scriptures.
8.translation: To show clearly by indirect experience the nature of dependence, he argues for the division of spirituality and others. This spiritual being, the seer, who is proud of the eyes and other senses, is the same superdivine being, the sun and others, who are the master of the eyes and other senses. There is a separation of both in the same two-form, from which the transcendental, visible body, perceived by the eye, the sphere, etc., is the soul, and the soul is the soul. That or this Purusha is made up of food and taste, according to the original scriptures.

9.word_for_word: एकम् एकतराभाव इत्य् एतेषाम् अन्योन्य-सापेक्ष-सिद्धित्वेनानात्मत्वं दर्शयति । — The fact that one is the absence of the other shows that these are not self-realized by their relative perfection.; तथाहि । — That’s right.; दृश्यं विना तत्-प्रतीत्य्-अनुमेयं करणं न सिध्यति, नापि द्रष्टा, न च तद् विना करण-प्रवृत्त्य्-अनुमेयस् तद्-अधिष्ठाता सूर्यादिः, न च तं विना कारणं प्रवर्तते, न च तद् विना दृश्यम् इत्य् एवम् एकतरस्याभावे एकं नोपलभामहे । — Without the sight, the inferential action of that perception is not accomplished, nor is the seer, nor is the sun and others that are inferred from the instinct of action without it, nor does the cause operate without it, nor is the sight without it.; तत्र तदा तत् त्रितयम् आलोचनात्मकेन प्रत्ययेन यो वेद साक्षितया पश्यति स परमात्मा आश्रयः । — There then, with critical conviction, he who knows and witnesses that trinity is the Supreme Self, the refuge.; तेषाम् अपि परस्परम् आश्रयत्वम् अस्त्य् एवेति तद्-व्यवच्छेदार्थं विशेषणम् । — They also have interdependence, which is an adjective to distinguish them.; स्वाश्रयोऽनन्याश्रयः स चासाव् अन्येषाम् आश्रयश् चेति ॥९॥ — He who depends on himself is dependent on no other and that he is dependent on others.
9.translation: The fact that one is the absence of the other shows that these are not self-realized by their relative perfection. That’s right. Without the sight, the inferential action of that perception is not accomplished, nor is the seer, nor is the sun and others that are inferred from the instinct of action without it, nor does the cause operate without it, nor is the sight without it. There then, with critical conviction, he who knows and witnesses that trinity is the Supreme Self, the refuge. They also have interdependence, which is an adjective to distinguish them. He who depends on himself is dependent on no other and that he is dependent on others.

10.word_for_word: उक्तम् एवाध्यात्मादि-विभागं प्रपञ्चयन्—“यद् उताहं त्वया पृष्टो वैराजात् पुरुषादिदम् । — He has already said this, explaining the division of spirituality and other things into two parts; यथासीत् तद्-उपाख्यास्ये” इति यत् प्रतिज्ञातं तद् उत्पत्ति-प्रकारम् आह—पुरुष इत्य्-आदिना । — I will tell you as it was.” He explains the type of origin that was promised by saying, “A man.”; पुरुषो वैराजोऽण्डं विनिर्भिद्य पृथक् कृत्य विनिर्गतः, पृथक् स्थित इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Vairāja, tore the egg apart and came out, and remained separate.; अयनं स्थानम् अन्विच्छन् विमृशन् । — They searched for the place of the moon and contemplated it.; यतः शुचिः स्वयम् । — Because he is pure himself.; अतः शुचीः शुद्धा अपो गर्भोदक-संज्ञा अस्राक्षीत् ससर्ज ॥१०॥ — Therefore the pure and pure waters, known as the waters of the womb, emerged and evolved.
10.translation: He has already said this, explaining the division of spirituality and other things into two parts I will tell you as it was.” He explains the type of origin that was promised by saying, “A man.” This means that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Vairāja, tore the egg apart and came out, and remained separate. They searched for the place of the moon and contemplated it. Because he is pure himself. Therefore the pure and pure waters, known as the waters of the womb, emerged and evolved.

11.word_for_word: अप्सु वासं नारायण-नाम-निरुक्त्या स्पष्टयति । — He explains his dwelling in the waters by the interpretation of the name of Nārāyaṇa.; तेन अप्सु वासेन । — By that dwelling in the waters.; यद् यस्मात् पुरुषो नरः, तस्माद् उद्भवो यासां, ता नारा आपोऽयनम् अस्येति नारायण इत्य् अर्थः । — That which is from which the Purusha is a man, and from which the Nara originates, is the water of the Ayana, which means Nārāyaṇa.; तद् उक्तम्— “आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नर-सूनवः । — That is said: “The waters are called Nara, and the waters are the sons of men.; अयनं तस्य ताः पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः ॥” इति ॥११॥ — That is why he was known as Nārāyaṇa in the past.” It is said.
11.translation: He explains his dwelling in the waters by the interpretation of the name of Nārāyaṇa. By that dwelling in the waters. That which is from which the Purusha is a man, and from which the Nara originates, is the water of the Ayana, which means Nārāyaṇa. That is said: “The waters are called Nara, and the waters are the sons of men. That is why he was known as Nārāyaṇa in the past.” It is said.

12.word_for_word: तस्य प्रभावम् आह । — He argues for its effect.; द्रव्यम् उपादानम् । — Matter is the element.; कर्मादीनि निमित्तानि । — Karma and other causes.; जीवो भोक्ता । — The living being is the enjoyer.; यस्यानुग्रहात् सन्ति, कार्य-क्षमा भवन्तीत्य् अर्थः ॥१२॥ — This means that by the grace of whom they are, they are able to do their work.
12.translation: He argues for its effect. Matter is the element. Karma and other causes. The living being is the enjoyer. This means that by the grace of whom they are, they are able to do their work.

13.word_for_word: [विष्वास-प्रस्तुतौ अस्मिन् श्लोके पृथक् श्रीधर-स्वामी-व्याख्या न दृश्यते।] — [There is no separate explanation of Sridhar Swami in this verse in the presentation of faith.
13.translation: [There is no separate explanation of Sridhar Swami in this verse in the presentation of faith.

14.word_for_word: तस्यैव प्रपञ्चः अथेत्य् आदिना ॥१४॥ — The universe of that very thing is therefore by the beginning.
14.translation: The universe of that very thing is therefore by the beginning.

15.word_for_word: अन्तः शरीरे य आकाशस् तस्मात् क्रिया-शक्त्या तत्र विविधं चेष्टमानस्य सतः । — The sky within the body is therefore the power of action of the Supreme Being, who moves in various ways there.; ओज इन्द्रिय-शक्तिः । — Oz is the power of the senses.; सहो मनः-शक्तिः । — Saho is the power of the mind.; बलं देह-शक्तिः । — Strength is the power of the body.; ततः शक्त्य्-आत्मकात् सूक्ष्माद् रूपात् प्राणः सूत्राख्यः । — Then, from the subtle form of the energy-self, the life-force is called the thread.; महान् मुख्यः । — The great chief.; असुः प्राणः सर्वेषाम् ॥१५॥ — Asu is the life force of all.
15.translation: The sky within the body is therefore the power of action of the Supreme Being, who moves in various ways there. Oz is the power of the senses. Saho is the power of the mind. Strength is the power of the body. Then, from the subtle form of the energy-self, the life-force is called the thread. The great chief. Asu is the life force of all.

16.word_for_word: महत्त्वं दर्शयति । — It shows the importance.; प्राणा इन्द्रियाणि यं प्राणन्तं चेष्टां कुर्वन्तम् अनु पश्चात् प्राणन्ति चेष्टां कुर्वन्ति । — The life-force, the senses, follow the living entity in action, and afterwards the life-force follows him in action.; अपानन्तं चेष्टां त्यजन्तम् अनु अपानन्ति चेष्टां त्यजन्ति । — They follow the one who is taking away the action and gives up the action.; राजानम् अनु भृत्या इव ॥१६॥ — They followed the king like servants.
16.translation: It shows the importance. The life-force, the senses, follow the living entity in action, and afterwards the life-force follows him in action. They follow the one who is taking away the action and gives up the action. They followed the king like servants.

17.word_for_word: क्षिपता चालयता निमित्तेन क्षुत्-तृडादिकम् । — When throwing, moving, hunger, thirst, etc., on occasion.; प्रभोर् इति विराड्-जीवाभेदेन उपासनार्थम् उक्तम् । — Prabhor is said to be worshiped by the distinction between the Cosmic and the living entities.; आजायते स्म । — It was born.; ततो जक्षतः, भक्षयितुम् इच्छत इत्य् अर्थः । — Then they eat, meaning they want to eat.; प्राक् प्रथमम् । — Previously the first.; निरभिद्यत विभक्तम् अभूत् ॥१७॥ — It was torn apart and divided.
17.translation: When throwing, moving, hunger, thirst, etc., on occasion. Prabhor is said to be worshiped by the distinction between the Cosmic and the living entities. It was born. Then they eat, meaning they want to eat. Previously the first. It was torn apart and divided.

18.word_for_word: ताल्व् अधिष्ठानम्, जिह्वेन्द्रियम्, नाना-रसो विषयः, वरुणश् च देवता ज्ञातव्या । — The palm is the seat, the sense of the tongue, the object of various tastes, and Varuna is to be understood as the deity.; एवं सर्वत्राधिष्ठानम् इन्द्रियं देवता विषय इत्य् एतच् चतुष्टयम् अनुक्तम् अप्य् ऊह्यम् ॥१८॥ — Thus these four elements, namely the senses, the demigods and the objects, are the omnipresent, even if they are not expressed.
18.translation: The palm is the seat, the sense of the tongue, the object of various tastes, and Varuna is to be understood as the deity. Thus these four elements, namely the senses, the demigods and the objects, are the omnipresent, even if they are not expressed.

19.word_for_word: विवक्षोर् वक्तुम् इच्छोः मुखत एव । — It is from the mouth of the one who wants to speak.; वह्निर् देवता, वाग् इन्द्रियम्, व्याहृतं भाषणम् । — Fire is the deity, speech is the sense, and speech is the spoken word.; तयोर् इतीन्द्रिय-देवताधीनत्वं कर्मणो दर्शयति ॥१९॥ — This shows that action is subject to the senses and the deity of the two.
19.translation: It is from the mouth of the one who wants to speak. Fire is the deity, speech is the sense, and speech is the spoken word. This shows that action is subject to the senses and the deity of the two.

20.word_for_word: [विष्वास-प्रस्तुतौ १९-२० संयुक्त-प्रकरणे अस्य द्वितीयार्धस्य पृथक् श्रीधर-स्वामी-व्याख्या न प्रदत्ता।] — [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation of this second half is given in the joint chapter 19-20 in the Vishwas Presentation.
20.translation: [No separate Sridhar Swami explanation of this second half is given in the joint chapter 19-20 in the Vishwas Presentation.

21.word_for_word: निरालोकं प्रकाश-शून्यम् आसीद् इति शेषः । — The rest is that it was lightless and empty of light.; निर्मक्षिकम् इतिवद् अव्ययीभावः । — The infinitive is like nirmakshikam.; तदा आत्मानं देहं च-काराद् अन्यच् च वस्तु दिदृक्षतः । — Then you want to see yourself and your body and something else besides the car.; अक्षिणी स्थानम्, ज्योतिर् आदित्यो देवता, चक्षुर् इन्द्रियम्, ततो गुणस्य रूपस्य ग्रहो ग्रहणम् । — The eye is the place, the light is the sun, the deity, the eye is the sense, and then the planet is the grasp of the form of the quality.; अनेन रूपं विषयो दर्शितः ॥२१॥ — This shows the form and the object.
21.translation: The rest is that it was lightless and empty of light. The infinitive is like nirmakshikam. Then you want to see yourself and your body and something else besides the car. The eye is the place, the light is the sun, the deity, the eye is the sense, and then the planet is the grasp of the form of the quality. This shows the form and the object.

22.word_for_word: ऋषिभिर् वेदैर् बोध्यमानस्य । — He was enlightened by the sages and the Vedas.; तद् आत्मनः प्रबोधनं ग्रहीतुम् इच्छतः । — That’s the awakening of the self that you want to grasp.; ततो गुण-ग्रहः शब्दस्य ग्रहणम् ॥२२॥ — Then the grasp of the modes is the grasp of sound.
22.translation: He was enlightened by the sages and the Vedas. That’s the awakening of the self that you want to grasp. Then the grasp of the modes is the grasp of sound.

23.word_for_word: मृदुत्वं च काठिन्यं च लघुत्वं च गुरुत्वं च आ उष्णत्वम् ईषद् उष्णत्वं च शीततां चेत्य् अर्थः । — It means softness, hardness, lightness, heaviness, a warmth, slight warmth and coldness.; वस्तुन एतान् धर्मान् जिघृक्षतस् त्वङ् निर्भिन्ना । — The skin was torn apart when the object tried to conquer these religions.; त्वग्-इन्द्रियाधिष्ठानं चर्म जातम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the skin has become the seat of the skin senses.; तस्यां रोमाणीन्द्रियं, मही-रुहाश् च देवता जाताः । — In her the hairs became the senses and the earth and the trees became the gods.; तत्र त्वच्य् अन्तर् बहिश् च वातो वृत आवृत्य स्थितः । — There, the air inside and outside the skin is wrapped and covered.; कथम्भूतः ? — How did it happen?; त्वचा लब्धो गुणः स्पर्शो येन ॥२३॥ — The skin is obtained by the quality of touch.
23.translation: It means softness, hardness, lightness, heaviness, a warmth, slight warmth and coldness. The skin was torn apart when the object tried to conquer these religions. This means that the skin has become the seat of the skin senses. In her the hairs became the senses and the earth and the trees became the gods. There, the air inside and outside the skin is wrapped and covered. How did it happen? The skin is obtained by the quality of touch.

24.word_for_word: रुरुहतुर् निर्भिन्नौ । — They cried and separated.; बलम् इन्द्रियम्, इन्द्रो देवता, तद्-उभयाश्रयम् आदानं कर्म ॥२४॥ — Strength is the sense, Indra is the deity, and the exchange of both depends on the action.
24.translation: They cried and separated. Strength is the sense, Indra is the deity, and the exchange of both depends on the action.

25.word_for_word: अभिकामिकाम् अभीष्टां हिताम् इत्य् अर्थः । — It means the desirous, the desired, the good.; पद्भ्यां सह यज्ञो विष्णुर् एव स्वयं तद्-अधिष्ठातृ-रूपेण स्थितः । — Along with the feet, the sacrifice is performed by Lord Viṣṇu Himself, who is present as the presiding deity.; कर्मभिर् इति गत्य्-आख्या कर्म-शक्तिर् इन्द्रियम् उक्तम् । — By actions, the sense of action, called gaty, is said to be the power of action.; हव्यं क्रियत इति गति-प्राप्यं यज्ञार्थं द्रव्यं विषय इत्य् उक्तम् ॥२५॥ — Havyam is said to be the object of the sacrifice, the object of the sacrifice, which is attainable by movement.
25.translation: It means the desirous, the desired, the good. Along with the feet, the sacrifice is performed by Lord Viṣṇu Himself, who is present as the presiding deity. By actions, the sense of action, called gaty, is said to be the power of action. Havyam is said to be the object of the sacrifice, the object of the sacrifice, which is attainable by movement.

26.word_for_word: प्रजा अपत्यम् आनन्दो रतिर् अमृतं स्वर्गादि तद्-अर्थिनः । — They seek progeny, children, joy, passion, nectar, heaven and so on.; शिश्नोऽधिष्ठानम् उपस्थम् इन्द्रियं प्रजापतिश् चासीद् इति ज्ञेयम् । — It should be understood that the genitals were the seat of the senses and the creator was the subtle body.; तद्-उभयाश्रयं कामानां सम्बन्धि प्रियं सुखम् ॥२६॥ — That is the pleasant happiness in relation to desires which depends on both.
26.translation: They seek progeny, children, joy, passion, nectar, heaven and so on. It should be understood that the genitals were the seat of the senses and the creator was the subtle body. That is the pleasant happiness in relation to desires which depends on both.

27.word_for_word: धातु-मलं भुक्तान्नादीनाम् असारांशं त्यक्तुम् इच्छोः । — You want to give up the mineral impurities and the insignificant parts of the food you eat.; गुद-पायु-मित्रोत्सर्गा अधिष्ठानेन्द्रिय-देवता-विषयाः ॥२७॥ — The anus, air, friendly excretions are the objects of the abode, the senses and the demigods.
27.translation: You want to give up the mineral impurities and the insignificant parts of the food you eat. The anus, air, friendly excretions are the objects of the abode, the senses and the demigods.

28.word_for_word: पुर्या देहात् पुरो देहान्तराणि आसिसृप्सोः सर्वतो गन्तुम् इच्छोः । — They wanted to move from one body to another, but they wanted to move from one body to another.; नाभि-द्वारं निरभिद्यतेत्य् अनुषङ्गः । — The attachment is that the navel gate is opened.; अपानतोऽपगच्छतः । — They’re going away from the breath.; पृथक्त्वं मरणम् । — Separation is death.; नाभ्यां हि प्राणापानयोर् बन्ध-विश्लेषे मृत्युर् इति प्रसिद्धम् ॥२८॥ — It is well known that death is the result of the breaking of bondage between the navel and the breathing and expiration.
28.translation: They wanted to move from one body to another, but they wanted to move from one body to another. The attachment is that the navel gate is opened. They’re going away from the breath. Separation is death. It is well known that death is the result of the breaking of bondage between the navel and the breathing and expiration.

29.word_for_word: अन्न-पानानाम् आदित्सोः संग्रहेच्छोः कुक्षिश् चान्त्राणि च नाड्यश् चासन् । — The abdomen, intestines and veins were the sources of the sun’s desire to collect food and drink.; तत्र कुक्षिर् अधिष्ठानम् । — There, the abdomen is the seat.; अन्त्राण्य् अन्न-संग्रहे करणम् इन्द्रिय-स्थानीयम् । — The intestines are the place of the senses in the collection of food.; नाड्यस् तु पानं ग्रहे । — The veins are the drinking planet.; तयोर् नाड्य्-अन्त्र-वर्गयोः क्रमेण नद्यः समुद्राश् च देवते । — The rivers and the seas are the deity of the two veins and the intestinal classes, respectively.; तुष्टिर् उदर-भरणं, पुष्टिस् तु रस-परिणामतः स्थौल्यम् ॥२९॥ — Satisfaction is the filling of the stomach, and nourishment is the result of taste.
29.translation: The abdomen, intestines and veins were the sources of the sun’s desire to collect food and drink. There, the abdomen is the seat. The intestines are the place of the senses in the collection of food. The veins are the drinking planet. The rivers and the seas are the deity of the two veins and the intestinal classes, respectively. Satisfaction is the filling of the stomach, and nourishment is the result of taste.

30.word_for_word: निदिध्यासोर् नितरां चिन्तयितुम् इच्छोः । — They wanted to meditate and think constantly.; कामोऽभिलाषः । — Lust is desire.; हृदय-मनश् चन्द्र-संकल्पा अधिष्ठानादयः ॥३०॥ — The heart, mind, moon, resolutions, positions and so on.
30.translation: They wanted to meditate and think constantly. Lust is desire. The heart, mind, moon, resolutions, positions and so on.

31.word_for_word: तद् एवम् अधिदैवादि-भेदं विभज्योक्त्वा तद्-अंश-भूतानां धात्व्-आदीनं स्वरूपम् आह—त्वग् इति द्वाभ्याम् । — After thus dividing the distinction between the supernatural and the supernatural, he describes the nature of the beings that are part of it, namely, the skin and the others.; त्वक् स्थूलम् । — The skin is thick.; चर्म तद्-उपरि स्थितं सूक्ष्मम् । — The skin on top of it is fine.; त्वग्-आदयोऽस्थ्य्-अन्ता द्वन्द्वैकवद् भावेन निर्दिष्टाः सप्त ये धातवस् ते भूम्य्-अप्-तेजो-मयाः । — The seven elements, beginning with the skin and ending with the bones, are designated as one duality and are composed of the earth, water and fire.; तेषां च पाञ्च-भौतिकत्वेऽपि वाय्व्-आकाशयोर् आहारादि-रूपेण संवर्धकत्वाभावाद् एवम् उक्तम् ॥३१॥ — And even though they are five-material, the air and the sky are not enhancers in the form of food and other things, so it has been said.
31.translation: After thus dividing the distinction between the supernatural and the supernatural, he describes the nature of the beings that are part of it, namely, the skin and the others. The skin is thick. The skin on top of it is fine. The seven elements, beginning with the skin and ending with the bones, are designated as one duality and are composed of the earth, water and fire. And even though they are five-material, the air and the sky are not enhancers in the form of food and other things, so it has been said.

32.word_for_word: गुणात्मकानि गुणेषु शब्दादिष्व् आत्मा येषाम्, विषयाभिमुख-स्वभावानीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that those whose soul is in the modes of nature, such as sound, are object-oriented in nature.; गुणाः शब्दादयः । — The qualities are sound and others.; भूतादिर् अहंकारस् ततः प्रकर्षेण भवन्तीति तथा । — The ego, which is the origin of the beings, then becomes the source of the universe.; अत्र हेतुः—यतो मन एव सर्व-विकाराणाम् आत्मा स्वरूपम् । — The reason for this is that the mind is the soul form of all transformations.; बुद्धिस् तु तथाभूतार्थ-विज्ञान-रूपिणी ॥३२॥ — Intelligence, however, is in the form of knowledge of the meaning of such things.
32.translation: This means that those whose soul is in the modes of nature, such as sound, are object-oriented in nature. The qualities are sound and others. The ego, which is the origin of the beings, then becomes the source of the universe. The reason for this is that the mind is the soul form of all transformations. Intelligence, however, is in the form of knowledge of the meaning of such things.

33.word_for_word: उपसंहरति—एतद् इति । — He concludes—this is it.; प्रकृत्या सहाष्टभिः ॥३३॥ — with the eight by nature.
33.translation: He concludes—this is it. with the eight by nature.

34.word_for_word: स्थूलम् उक्त्वा सूक्ष्मं समष्टि-लिङ्ग-शरीरम् आह । — He spoke of the gross as the subtle body of the whole body.; अतः परमस्य कारण-भूतं सूक्ष्मम् अतीन्द्रियम् । — Therefore, the subtle transcendental is the cause of the Supreme.; यतोऽव्यक्तम् । — Because it is unmanifest.; तत् कुतः ? — Where is that from?; यतो निर्विशेषणम् अनादि-मध्य-निधनम् उत्पत्ति-स्थिति-लय-शून्यम् । — Because it is devoid of attributes, eternal, middle and dead, it is void of origin, state and rhythm.; नित्यं सदैक-रूपम्, अपक्षयादि-शून्यम् इत्य् अर्थः । — It means that it is eternal and always-form, void of decay and other things.; अत एव वाक् च मनश् चेति द्वन्द्वैक्यम् । — That is why there is a duality between speech and mind.; तस्मात् परम् ॥३४॥ — Beyond that.
34.translation: He spoke of the gross as the subtle body of the whole body. Therefore, the subtle transcendental is the cause of the Supreme. Because it is unmanifest. Where is that from? Because it is devoid of attributes, eternal, middle and dead, it is void of origin, state and rhythm. It means that it is eternal and always-form, void of decay and other things. That is why there is a duality between speech and mind. Beyond that.

35.word_for_word: उपासनार्थं भगवत्य् आरोपितं रूप-द्वयम् अपवदति—अमुनी इति । — He rejects the two forms attributed to the Lord for worship—Amuni.; न गृह्णन्ति वस्तुतो नाङ्गीकुर्वन्ति । — They do not accept it, in fact, they do not accept it.; यतो माया-सृष्टे ॥३५॥ — Because in the creation of illusion.
35.translation: He rejects the two forms attributed to the Lord for worship—Amuni. They do not accept it, in fact, they do not accept it. Because in the creation of illusion.

36.word_for_word: यद् रूप-गुण-कर्मकः इति यद् उक्तं भगवता ब्रह्माणं प्रति तत् प्रपञ्चयितुं ब्रह्मादि-रूपाणि तत्-कर्माणि चाह—स इत्य्-आदिना । — To explain what the Supreme Personality of Godhead has said to the Absolute Truth about the form, quality and action of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He explains the forms of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and His actions.; स भगवान् ब्रह्म-रूप-धृक् सन् वाच्य-वाचकतया नामानि वाच्यतया रूपाणि क्रियाश् च धत्ते, सृजतीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, assuming the form of the Absolute Truth, assumes names, forms and actions in the form of expressions and creates them.; मायया स-कर्मा स-व्यापारः सन् वस्तुतस् त्व् अकर्मकः ॥३६॥ — By illusion he is co-action and co-transaction but in reality he is inactive.
36.translation: To explain what the Supreme Personality of Godhead has said to the Absolute Truth about the form, quality and action of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He explains the forms of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and His actions. This means that the Supreme Personality of Godhead, assuming the form of the Absolute Truth, assumes names, forms and actions in the form of expressions and creates them. By illusion he is co-action and co-transaction but in reality he is inactive.

37.word_for_word: एतत् प्रपञ्चयति—प्रजापतीन् इति सार्धैस् त्रिभिः । — This is what he argues—the creators, with three and a half.; द्वितीयान्तानां धत्त इत्य् अनेनान्वयः । — This is the consequence of the secondary endings, dhatta.; तत्र प्रजा-पत्य्-आदीनि नामानि तत्-तद्-वाच्यानि रूपाणि तत्-तत्-कर्माणि च ज्ञेयानि पृथक् तत्-तद्-अवान्तर-भेदेन ॥३७-३८॥ — There the names of the subjects, husbands and others, the forms expressed by them and their actions should be understood separately by distinguishing between them and their subordinates. 37-3
37.translation: This is what he argues—the creators, with three and a half. This is the consequence of the secondary endings, dhatta. There the names of the subjects, husbands and others, the forms expressed by them and their actions should be understood separately by distinguishing between them and their subordinates. 37-3

38.word_for_word: एतत् प्रपञ्चयति—प्रजापतीन् इति सार्धैस् त्रिभिः । — This is what he argues—the creators, with three and a half.; द्वितीयान्तानां धत्त इत्य् अनेनान्वयः । — This is the consequence of the secondary endings, dhatta.; तत्र प्रजा-पत्य्-आदीनि नामानि तत्-तद्-वाच्यानि रूपाणि तत्-तत्-कर्माणि च ज्ञेयानि पृथक् तत्-तद्-अवान्तर-भेदेन ॥३७-३८॥ — There the names of the subjects, husbands and others, the forms expressed by them and their actions should be understood separately by distinguishing between them and their subordinates. 37-3
38.translation: This is what he argues—the creators, with three and a half. This is the consequence of the secondary endings, dhatta. There the names of the subjects, husbands and others, the forms expressed by them and their actions should be understood separately by distinguishing between them and their subordinates. 37-3

39.word_for_word: गिरीन् इत्य् अस्यानन्तरं नृपेति सम्बोधनम् । — Girin, after this, is addressed as King.; द्वि-विधाः स्थावर-जङ्गम-रूपेण । — There are two types of movable and immovable.; चतुर्-विधाः जरायुजाण्डज-स्वेदजोद्भिज्ज-रूपेण । — There are four types of diseases: old age, eggs, sweat and embryos.; जल-स्थल-नभांस्य् ओकांसि येषां तान् अपि धत्त इति पूर्वेणान्वयः ॥३९॥ — The consequence of the former is that he also holds the oaks which are in the water, land and sky.
39.translation: Girin, after this, is addressed as King. There are two types of movable and immovable. There are four types of diseases: old age, eggs, sweat and embryos. The consequence of the former is that he also holds the oaks which are in the water, land and sky.

40.word_for_word: यच् च राज्ञा पृष्टं यावत्यः कर्म-गतयो यादृशीर् द्विज-सत्तम इति तस्यापि प्रसङ्गाद् अनेनैवोत्तरम् आह । — And when the king asked him what the course of action was, O best of the brāhmaṇas, he replied in the same way.; कुशला उत्तमाः, अकुशला नीचाः । — The skilled are good, the unskilled are bad.; मिश्रा इति पदान्तरम् । — Mixed is another term.; मिश्रा मध्यमाः । — Mixed mediums.; कर्मणां पुण्य-पाप-मिश्राणां गतयः फलानि । — The movements and fruits of actions are a mixture of good and evil.; सत्त्वादि-भेदेन कर्म-गति-वैचित्र्यं प्रपञ्चयति—सत्त्वम् इति सार्धेन ॥४०-४१॥ — By the distinction between Sattva and others he explains the peculiarities of the movement of action—with Sattva in the middle.40-4
40.translation: And when the king asked him what the course of action was, O best of the brāhmaṇas, he replied in the same way. The skilled are good, the unskilled are bad. Mixed is another term. Mixed mediums. The movements and fruits of actions are a mixture of good and evil. By the distinction between Sattva and others he explains the peculiarities of the movement of action—with Sattva in the middle.40-4

41.word_for_word: सत्त्वादयस् तिस्रो गतयः । — There are three movements, beginning with Sattva.; सुरादि-शब्दा ऋस्य्-आदीनाम् उपलक्षणार्थाः । — The words sura and others have the meaning of sub-characteristics of sages and others.; अन्याभ्यां गुणाभ्यां स्वभावो गुण उपहन्यतेऽनुविध्यते ॥४०-४१॥ — By the other two modes of nature the mode of nature is destroyed and followed (40-41).
41.translation: There are three movements, beginning with Sattva. The words sura and others have the meaning of sub-characteristics of sages and others. By the other two modes of nature the mode of nature is destroyed and followed (40-41).

42.word_for_word: ब्रह्म-रूपेण स्रष्टृत्वम् उक्त्वा विष्णु-रूपेण पालकत्वम् आह । — He said that He was the creator in the form of Brahma and that He was the protector in the form of Vishnu.; स एव भगवांस् तिर्यग्-आद्य्-अवतारैर् इदं विश्वं स्थापयन् पालयन् धर्म-रूपेण पुष्णाति भोगैः संवर्धयति ॥४२॥ — That same Supreme Personality of Godhead, by His incarnations like animals, establishes, maintains and nourishes this universe in the form of Dharma and enhances it with pleasures.
42.translation: He said that He was the creator in the form of Brahma and that He was the protector in the form of Vishnu. That same Supreme Personality of Godhead, by His incarnations like animals, establishes, maintains and nourishes this universe in the form of Dharma and enhances it with pleasures.

43.word_for_word: आत्मनः सकाशाद् यद् इदं सृष्टं तत् सन्नियच्छति संहरति । — He controls and withdraws whatever is created from Himself.; घनानीकं मेघ-समूहम् ॥४३॥ — The clouds are a mass of clouds.
43.translation: He controls and withdraws whatever is created from Himself. The clouds are a mass of clouds.

44.word_for_word: कर्तृत्वाद्य्-अपवादेन दशमस्य शुद्धिम् आह । — With the exception of being the doer, he argues for the purity of the tenth.; इत्थम्-भावेन स्रष्टृत्वादि-रूपेण श्रुत्या कथितः । — In this sense, He is described by the Vedas as the Creator and others.; सूरयस् तु परं केवलम् एवं-रूपेणैव द्रष्टुं नार्हन्ति ॥४४॥ — The suns, however, cannot see the Supreme Being in this form alone.
44.translation: With the exception of being the doer, he argues for the purity of the tenth. In this sense, He is described by the Vedas as the Creator and others. The suns, however, cannot see the Supreme Being in this form alone.

45.word_for_word: तत् किम् ? — What is that ?; यतः अस्य विश्वस्य जन्मादौ कर्मणि परस्येश्वरस्येत्थम्-भावः कर्तृत्वं नास्ति । — Because in the beginning of the birth of this universe, there is no such thing as the doership of the other God in the action.; श्रुत्यापि तात्पर्येण न प्रतिपाद्यते । — Even the scriptures do not prove it by its meaning.; किन्त्व् अनुविधीयतेऽनूद्यते । — but it is followed and translated.; किम्-अर्थम् ? — What-does it mean?; कर्तृत्व-प्रतिषेधार्थम् । — for the purpose of prohibiting doership.; हि यतो माययारोपितं प्रकाशितम् ॥४५॥ — For since it has been imposed by illusion it has been revealed.
45.translation: What is that ? Because in the beginning of the birth of this universe, there is no such thing as the doership of the other God in the action. Even the scriptures do not prove it by its meaning. but it is followed and translated. What-does it mean? for the purpose of prohibiting doership. For since it has been imposed by illusion it has been revealed.

46.word_for_word: उक्तम् अर्थम् उपसंहरति—अयं त्व् इति । — He concludes the meaning stated by saying, “This is you.”; ब्रह्मणः सम्बन्धी कल्पो महा-कल्पो विकल्पोऽवान्तरस् तत्-सहित उदाहरणत्वेन संक्षेपत उक्तः । — The Kalpa relating to the Brahman, the Maha-Kalpa, the Vikalpa and the Avantara, have been briefly mentioned as an example with it.; कथम्भूतः ? — How did it happen?; यत्र महा-कल्पे प्राकृता महद्-आदि-सर्गा अवान्तर-कल्पे च वैकृताः । — Whereas in the Maha-kalpa the ordinary creations of the great and the beginning are deformed in the Avantara-kalpa.; स्थावरा विसर्गा इत्य् अयं विधिः प्रकारोऽन्यैर् महा-कल्पादिभिः साधारणः ॥४६॥ — This method of dissolution of the immovable is common to other Maha-kalpas and others.
46.translation: He concludes the meaning stated by saying, “This is you.” The Kalpa relating to the Brahman, the Maha-Kalpa, the Vikalpa and the Avantara, have been briefly mentioned as an example with it. How did it happen? Whereas in the Maha-kalpa the ordinary creations of the great and the beginning are deformed in the Avantara-kalpa. This method of dissolution of the immovable is common to other Maha-kalpas and others.

47.word_for_word: वक्ष्यमाणं विस्तरं प्रतिजानीते । — He acknowledges the details being described.; परिमाणं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं च कल्पस्य लक्षणम् इयान् एवं-रूप इति तद्-विग्रहम् अवान्तर-कल्पं मन्वन्तरादि-रूपं विभागं च यथावद् विस्तरेण पुरस्तात् तृतीय-स्कन्धे व्याख्यास्यामि । — The measurement, the gross and the subtle, are the characteristics of the Kalpa, and I shall explain in detail the conflict between them, the Avantara Kalpa, the Manvantara and other forms, and the division of the Kalpa in due detail later in the third Skanda.; तत्र पाद्मं कल्पम् अथो इति कार्त्स्न्येन व्याख्यायमानं शृणु ॥४७॥ — There is the lotus Kalpa and then hear it explained in its entirety.
47.translation: He acknowledges the details being described. The measurement, the gross and the subtle, are the characteristics of the Kalpa, and I shall explain in detail the conflict between them, the Avantara Kalpa, the Manvantara and other forms, and the division of the Kalpa in due detail later in the third Skanda. There is the lotus Kalpa and then hear it explained in its entirety.

48.word_for_word: यद् अर्थं सृष्ट्य्-आदि-निरूपणं तद् एव साक्षाच् छ्रोतु-कामः कथान्तरं पृच्छति—यद् आहेति । — The meaning of the description of creation and the beginning of the universe is the very thing that the desire to hear directly asks for another story—that which is.; क्षत्ता विदुरः । — Kshatriya Vidura.; भुवः सम्बन्धीनि तीर्थानि । — The holy places related to the earth.; यद् वा, भुवः क्षेत्राणि चेति ॥४८॥ — or, the fields of the earth.
48.translation: The meaning of the description of creation and the beginning of the universe is the very thing that the desire to hear directly asks for another story—that which is. Kshatriya Vidura. The holy places related to the earth. or, the fields of the earth.

49.word_for_word: कौषारवेर् मैत्रेयस्य तस्य क्षत्तुश् चाध्यात्म-ज्ञान-संश्रितः संवादः ॥४९॥ — The conversation between Kausharava and Maitreya and his Kshatriyas is based on spiritual knowledge.
49.translation: The conversation between Kausharava and Maitreya and his Kshatriyas is based on spiritual knowledge.

50.word_for_word: पुनर् आगतवान् तत्र च निमित्तं ब्रूहि ॥५०॥ — I came back and tell me the reason for it.
50.translation: I came back and tell me the reason for it.

51.word_for_word: राज्ञा पृष्ट इति । — asked by the king.; अयम् अर्थः—यद् यूयं पृच्छथ इदम् एव राजापि शुकं पृष्टवान् । — This means that the king asked Shuka what you are asking.; शुकोऽपि विदुर-मैत्रेय-संवादं पुरस्कृत्य ये पूर्वं राज्ञा कृताः प्रश्नास् तद्-अनुसारेण सर्वं पुराणार्थम् अवोचन् । — Śukadeva Gosvāmī also rewarded the conversation between Vidura and Maitreya and explained the meaning of the Purāṇas in accordance with the questions asked by the king earlier; तद् एवाहं वोऽभिधास्यामि तथैव शृणुतेति ॥५१॥ — That very thing I shall tell you, so listen.
51.translation: asked by the king. This means that the king asked Shuka what you are asking. Śukadeva Gosvāmī also rewarded the conversation between Vidura and Maitreya and explained the meaning of the Purāṇas in accordance with the questions asked by the king earlier That very thing I shall tell you, so listen.
